tagline: Discuss product charts and cohorts with Amplitude
description:
Bring Amplitude product analytics into APX through the charts and cohorts available to your account. Choose the analysis you want to discuss and use its returned information to explain patterns or compare the populations represented.

A chart depends on its definitions, filters and time range. Keep those alongside the interpretation, and distinguish an observed pattern from an explanation of its cause. Available analyses depend on Amplitude's tools, account permissions and plan; connecting the extension does not include a subscription or change the underlying data collection.
prompts: Review the Amplitude chart I select and state the time range shown in its available data.
Explain the available definition of the cohort I choose.
Compare the selected chart results and distinguish observations from possible explanations.

es.description:
Traé analítica de producto de Amplitude a APX mediante los gráficos y las cohortes disponibles para tu cuenta. Elegí el análisis que querés conversar y usá la información devuelta para explicar patrones o comparar las poblaciones representadas.

Los análisis disponibles dependen de las herramientas de Amplitude, tus permisos y tu plan; conectar la extensión no incluye una suscripción ni cambia la recolección de datos.

Explicame la definición disponible de la cohorte que seleccione.
Compará los resultados elegidos y distinguí observaciones de posibles explicaciones.
